root_cause_identification.expected_solution: Agent must identify the nats.go pull entry point (js.go::PullSubscribe and the nextRequest it sends) AND the server-side seam (server/consumer.go::checkPending or nextWaiting plus server/filestore.go::EraseMsg). The report must name both repos and explain that retention erasing a message while it is still in the consumer's pending map is the source of the 'bad pending entry, sequence out of range' error.
evaluation_criteria: Names js.go (or PullSubscribe / nextRequest) on the nats.go side
Names server/consumer.go (checkPending or nextWaiting) on the nats-server side
Names server/filestore.go (EraseMsg / retention) as the racing path
States that a pending sequence is erased by retention before the consumer reconciles, producing 'out of range' or a silent skip

error_chain_trace.expected_solution: Agent must trace at least four hops: client PullSubscribe -> server nextWaiting/checkPending -> filestore EraseMsg -> pending-sequence-below-FirstSeq -> client receives no-messages-available and silently advances to next live sequence on retry.
evaluation_criteria: Mentions client pull request entry (PullSubscribe / nextRequest / fetch)
Mentions server consumer pending tracking (checkPending or nextWaiting)
Mentions filestore retention / EraseMsg as the racing actor
Mentions the silent gap or skipped sequence range observed by the downstream sink

affected_components.expected_solution: Agent must name the nats.go JetStream client, the nats-server consumer subsystem, and the JetStream filestore as the affected components.
evaluation_criteria: Names the nats.go JetStream client (js.go / PullSubscribe / pull consumer)
Names the nats-server consumer subsystem (server/consumer.go or pending map)
Names the JetStream filestore (server/filestore.go) or retention path

remediation_proposal.expected_solution: Agent must propose at least one concrete remediation: (a) server-side clamp of pending entries before retention erases blocks, (b) protocol-level explicit gap/skip signal in the pull response, OR (c) client-side sequence-contiguity check that surfaces ErrSequenceGap.
evaluation_criteria: Proposes one of: server-side clamp/lock, protocol gap signal, or client-side gap detection
Identifies where the fix would live (nats-server filestore/consumer, the wire protocol, or nats.go js.go)
